text:
Yes. Profit has been turning into cash, and slightly more than fully.

Full year:
- Operating cash flow was 1.15x PAT over the last 3 years. In FY26 it was ₹33,986cr against ₹29,474cr PAT. [Numbers]
- FY26 free cash flow (FCF) was ₹31,259cr, or 1.06x PAT. That is down from 1.25x in FY25 (₹33,457cr). [Numbers]

Recent quarters:
- Q2 FCF was $928mn, 113% of net profit. Q1 was $955mn, 116.5%. [Q2FY27 call]

Watch:
- Cash conversion is still above 1x but has slipped from FY25's peak.
- Debtor days rose from 63 in FY23 to 72 in FY26, so clients are paying more slowly. [Numbers]
- Working-capital days improved from 54 to 33. [Numbers]

FCF yield is about 6.5% on the ₹4.78 lakh crore market cap. Debt-to-equity is 0.09, so payouts don't rely on borrowing. [Numbers]
